expected_visuals.1: A small glowing orange ball of light floats over a foggy dark sea
expected_visuals.2: Narrator in the dark water clinging to a capsized bangka
expected_visuals.3: An orange light appears in the fog ahead, hovering
expected_visuals.4: He swims after the light; it drifts slowly toward the shore
expected_visuals.5: Villagers with lanterns on the beach; mother kneels on the sand hugging a pair of worn rubber slippers, crying softly
expected_visuals.6: The narrator's hands begin to glow orange; the villagers don't see him

visual_review.instructions: Two frames per clip (a = 25%, b = 75%). Confirm each clip shows its expected visual, clips are in story order, no clip repeats, no text/watermark/garbled faces, characters stay consistent.
